Romaleo's largescale lizard (Alopoglossus romaleos) is known only from a small area of Magdalena department.
Peters' anadia (Anadia petersi) is a type of lizard known only from a single ill-defined locality in southern Ecuador (Loja province).
The Kilwa sharp-snouted worm lizard (Ancylocranium ionidesi) is known only from a few localities in southeastern Tanzania, including the Litipo Forest Reserve.
Wiegmann's tree lizard (Anisolepis undulatus) is a little-known species confined to southeastern Brazil, Uruguay and northeastern Argentina.
Cope's anole (Anolis cymbops) is known only from from its original collection in the 1860s from central Veracruz.
The Santa Marta anole (Anolis santamartae) is known only from two localities in the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta.

species.s: Scattered patches of lowland dry forest
species.e: Simmons' anole (Anolis simmonsi) is a type of lizard confined to a small area of southwestern Mexico (Oaxaca).
The Ecuadorian blind snake (Anomalepis flavapices) is known only from two specimens collected in northwestern Ecuador (Esmeraldas and Menabí provinces).
The Kinabalu giant blind snake (Anomochilus monticola) is known only from three specimens collected on Mount Kinabalu.
species.iucn: Anomochilus monticola Das, Lakim, Lim & Hui, 2008

species.e: The Anegada blind snake (Antillotyphlops catapontus) is confined to Anegada.
The Bolivian burrowing snake (Apostolepis dorbignyi) is known only from two specimens collected during the early nineteenth century from southern Bolivia (Tarija department).
Ruthven's burrowing snake (Apostolepis tenuis) is known only from two specimens collected during the early twentieth century from central and northwestern Bolivia (Beni and Santa Cruz departments).
The Sumatran worm snake (Argyrophis hypsobothrius) is known only from two specimens collected from an unknown locality in Sumatra.
The Koshun worm snake (Argyrophis koshunensis) is known only from a few specimens collected in the 1930s.
Oates' blind snake (Argyrophis oatesii) is known only from tiny, uninhabited Table Island in the Coco Islands.
The Opata whiptail lizard (Aspidoscelis opatae) is confined to a small area of northwestern Sonora.
Filippi's ground snake (Atractus favae) is known only from nineteenth-century records originating from somewhere in northern Guyana and Suriname.
Cope's bachia (Bachia pallidiceps) is a type of lizard known only from a few localities in eastern Panama (Darién province) and western Colombia (Chocó department).
The Mokwa worm lizard (Baikia africana) is known only from a few specimens collected from a single locality in western Nigeria (Niger state).
Stejneger's alligator lizard (Barisia levicollis) is known only from northern Mexico (Chihuahua).
The Ambonihazo velvet gecko (Blaesodactylus ambonihazo) is known only from a few specimens collected from Ankarafantsika National Park in northwestern Madagsacar (former Mahajanga province).
species.iucn: Blaesodactylus ambonihazo Bauer, Glaw, Gehring & Vences, 2011

species.e: The Bengkulu cat snake (Boiga bengkuluensis) is known only from isolated records in southern peninsular Thailand and Sumatra.
species.iucn: Boiga bengkuluensis Orlov, Kudryavtzev, Ryabov & Shumakov, 2003

species.e: Ranawane's cat snake (Boiga ranawanei) is known only from two localities in central Sri Lanka (Central province).
species.iucn: Boiga ranawanei Samarawickrama, Samarawickrama, Wijesena & Orlov, 2005

species.e: The Nicobar cat snake (Boiga wallachi) is confined to Great Nicobar and Little Nicobar.
The Mandady skink (Brachyseps mandady) is known only from the Masoala Peninsula in northeastern Madagascar (former Antsiranana province), where it is threatened by loss of habitat.
The Transkei dwarf chameleon (Bradypodion caffer) is confined to a small area of coastal forest in Eastern Cape province.
Lamberton's leaf chameleon (Brookesia lambertoni) is known only from a small area of central-eastern Madagascar (former Toamasina province).

The thick-tailed rock gecko (Bunopus crassicauda) is known only from a few specimens collected from the northwestern part of the Central Plateau in Iran, although it may perhaps occur as well in northeastern Syria.
Abramov's reed snake (Calamaria abramovi) is known only from two specimens collected from Mount Ngoc Linh.
The Nias reed snake (Calamaria abstrusa) is known only from a few specimens collected from Nias.
Forcart's reed snake (Calamaria forcarti) is known only from four specimens collected from two, widely-separated localities (northeastern Sumatra and the island of Nias).
The Belitung reed snake (Calamaria javanica) is known only from three specimens collected in 1891 on Belitung, and one other of doubtful provenance (“Java”).
The white-striped reed snake (Calamaria lateralis) is known only from two specimens collected from Mount Kinabalu in the late nineteenth century.
The Cocos Islands reed snake (Calamaria lautensis) is known only from three specimens collected on Cocos Island.
Ulmer's reed snake (Calamaria ulmeri) is known only from two specimens collected during the mid-twentieth century from northern Sumatra (Aceh province).
The Wuliang reed snake (Calamaria yunnanensis) is known only from a few specimens collected from Wuliang       Mountain.
The Mandjélia litter skink (Caledoniscincus terma) is confined to Mount Mandjélia.
Beddome's coral snake (Calliophis beddomei) is known only from a few specimens collected from three mid-elevation localities in southern India (Karnataka and Tamil Nadu).
The spotted coral snake (Calliophis gracilis) is known only from a few historical collections in east-central Sumatra, the southern Malay Peninsula, Singapore, and Penang Island.
The Isthmian-Atlantic galliwasp (Celestus adercus) is a type of lizard known only from two specimens collected in west-central Panama (Coclé and Colón provinces).
The Santa Marta galliwasp (Celestus ingridae) is a type of lizard known only from the slopes of Santa Marta Volcano.
The Petlalcala montane pit viper (Cerrophidion petlalcalensis) is known only from Cerro Petlalcala in western Veracruz.
species.iucn: Cerrophidion petlalcalensis López-Luna, Vogt & de la Torre-Loranca, 1999

species.e: Simony's cylindrical skink (Chalcides simonyi) is confined to Fuerteventura, Lanzarote and Lobos.
Necas' chameleon (Chamaeleo necasi) is known only from a few localities in southwestern Togo and southern Benin.
The Mpwapwa worm lizard (Chirindia mpwapwaensis) is known only from two specimens collected in east-central Tanzania.
The Fraser's Hill day gecko (Cnemaspis flavolineata) is known only from three specimens collected from Fraser's Hill.
The giant day gecko (Cnemaspis gigas) is confined to the Jos Plateau.
Jacobson's day gecko (Cnemaspis jacobsoni) is known only from a few specimens collected on Simeulue.
The Ondo Forest day gecko (Cnemaspis petrodroma) is confined to Idanre Hill.
Nguyenvansang's snake (Colubroelaps nguyenvansangi) is known only from two specimens collected in southern Vietnam (Binh Phuoc and Lam Dong provinces).
species.iucn: Colubroelaps nguyenvansangi Orlov, Kharin, Ananjeva, Nguyen & Nguyen, 2009

species.e: The Chiapan stripeless snake (Coniophanes alvarezi) is known only from a few specimens collected in a small area of west-central Chiapas.
Joana's black-striped snake (Coniophanes joanae) is known only from two, widely-separated localities in central and southern Panama.
The black-headed snake (Coniophanes melanocephalus) is known only from two specimens collected in Morelos and Puebla.
Sara's striped snake (Coniophanes sarae) is known only from two specimens collected in southern Michoacán.
The Fouta Djallon aquatic skink (Cophoscincopus senegalensis) is known only from small, fast-flowing streams in the Fouta Djallon Highlands.
The Ukinga girdled lizard (Cordylus ukingensis) is known only from two montane grassland localities in south-central Tanzania.
The Tancítaro rattlesnake (Crotalus tancitarensis) is known only from three specimens collected on Tancítaro Volcano, the first in 1941 and two more in 2002.
Richards' snake-eyed skink (Cryptoblepharus richardsi) is known only from Misima.
The Fly River snake-eyed skink (Cryptoblepharus xenikos) is known only from a few specimens collected from two savanna localities in southwestern Papua New Guinea.

The southern Honduran spiny-tailed iguana (Ctenosaura praeocularis) is confined to a small area of southern Honduras (Francisco Morazán and Choluteca departments), where it lives in a wide range of habitats and altitudes.
The Great Inagua slender blindsnake (Cubatyphlops paradoxus) is known only from two specimens collected on Great Inagua in 1967.
Boulenger's cylinder snake (Cylindrophis aruensis) is known only from the Aru Islands and Damar in the Barat Daya Islands.
The Senegal worm lizard (Cynisca senegalensis) is known only from Niokolo-Koba National Park in southeastern Senegal.
Aaron's bent-toed gecko (Cyrtodactylus aaroni) is known only from three localities within the Vogelkop Peninsula (Papua Barat province, Indonesia).
The Bundi bent-toed gecko (Cyrtodactylus arcanus) is known only from a small area of eastern Papua New Guinea.
Fea's bent-toed gecko (Cyrtodactylus feae) appears to be confined to the mountains of southeastern Myanmar and possibly adjacent northwestern Thailand.
The Salawati bent-toed gecko (Cyrtodactylus irianjayaensis) is known only from lowland forests on Salawati.
The Finisterre bent-toed gecko (Cyrtodactylus minor) is known only from three specimens collected in the foothills at the northern edge of the Finisterre Mountains.
Werner's spider gecko (Cyrtopodion gastrophole) is known only from two localities in southwestern Iran (Fars province).
Steiner's wall lizard (Darevskia steineri) is known only from a small area of the Kopet Dag Mountains in northeastern Iran.
The Karnataka bronzeback tree snake (Dendrelaphis chairecacos) is known only from a few specimens collected from two widely-separated localities within the Western Ghats (Karnataka and Kerala).
Hollinrake's bronzeback tree snake (Dendrelaphis hollinrakei) is confined to Shek Kwu Chau, a small island located west of Hong Kong.
The Trobriand bronzeback tree snake (Dendrelaphis papuensis) is known only from historical specimens with an unclear distribution within the Trobriand Islands.
Underwood's bronzeback tree snake (Dendrelaphis underwoodi) is known only from three specimens collected from plantations in western Java (Jawa Barat province).
The ornamental snake (Denisonia maculata) is a small venomous species confined to ephemeral wetland areas of central-eastern Queensland.
Smith's blind skink (Dibamus smithi) is known only from two localities in southern Vietnam (Lam Dong and Khanh Hoa provinces).
The banded water snake (Djokoiskandarus annulata) is known only from a few localities along the south-central coast of New Guinea and its satellite islands.
Joger's saw-scaled viper (Echis jogeri) is confined to southeastern Senegal and southwestern Mali.
Chelazzi's garter snake (Elapsoidea chelazzii) is known only from a small area of dry open woodland in southern Somalia.
The Admiralty five-striped emo skink (Emoia mivarti) is confined to Manus and perhaps a few nearby islands.
The Wissel Lakes emo skink (Emoia paniai) is confined to an area of the Central Highlands in western New Guinea (Papua Barat province, Indonesia).
The Sicilian pond turtle (Emys trinacris) is confined to the remaining wetlands of Sicily, where it appears to be relatively abundant.
species.iucn: Emys trinacris Fritz, Fattizzo, Guicking, Tripepi, Pennisi, Lenk, Joger & Wink, 2005

species.e: Chanard's water snake (Enhydris chanardi) is known only from the Chao Phraya freshwater swamp forest in central Thailand, where it is threatened by expansion of the city of Bangkok.
The Tay Minh water snake (Enhydris innominata) is known only from a few specimens collected in the Mekong River drainage of southern Vietnam.
Gans' supple skink (Eutropis gansi) is known only from the Kalakkad-Mundunthurai Tiger Reserve in Tamil Nadu.
Blanford's supple skink (Eutropis innotata) is known only from a few, mostly historical records in east-central India (Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh).
The Tehuantepec hook-nosed snake (Ficimia variegata) is confined to a small area of lowland rainforest in southern Mexico on the Isthmus of Tehuantepec (Veracruz and Oaxaca).
The Andranovaho skink (Flexiseps andranovahensis) is known only from three, widely-separated localities in coastal southwestern Madagascar (former Toliara province).
The Masoala skink (Flexiseps stylus) is known only from the Masoala Peninsula in northeastern Madagascar (former Antsiranana province), where it is threatened by loss of habitat.

species.s: Scattered patches of lowland dry forest
species.e: The Tehuantepec striped snake (Geagras redimitus) is confined to a small area of southern Mexico on the Isthmus of Tehuantepec (Oaxaca).
Leopold's dtella (Gehyra leopoldi) is a type of gecko known only from two localities on the Vogelkop Peninsula of western New Guinea (Papua Barat province, Indonesia).
The Betanien earth snake (Geophis betaniensis) is known only from two specimens collected from a single locality in west-central Colombia (Valle del Cauca department).
The Cerro Aquila earth snake (Geophis chalybeus) is known only from two specimens collected during the nineteenth century.

species.s: Scattered patches of lowland dry forest
species.e: The Tehuantepec earth snake (Geophis isthmicus) is known only from an indefinite type locality in southern Mexico on the Isthmus of Tehuantepec (Oaxaca).
The Coula earth skink (Geoscincus haraldmeieri) is known only from two specimens collected in the 1970s from central Grande Terre.
Flower's worm snake (Gerrhopilus floweri) is known only from fruit plantations near the city of Bangkok, central Thailand.
The few-scaled worm snake (Gerrhopilus oligolepis) is known only from a small area of northeastern India (Sikkim and West Bengal).
Thurston's worm snake (Gerrhopilus thurstoni) is known only from three historical collections during the nineteeth century within the Western Ghats (Kerala and Tamil Nadu).
Tindall's worm snake (Gerrhopilus tindalli) is known only from two specimens collected in the 1940s from Kerala.
The Lijiang pit viper (Gloydius monticola) is confined to the mountains of southern China (northwestern Yunnan).
The Chapa flat-nosed keelback (Hebius chapaensis) is known only from a small area of montane forest in northern Vietnam, where it was last reported in the early twentieth century.
Groundwater's keelback (Hebius groundwateri) is a type of snake confined to a small area of peninsular Thailand (Ranong and Chumphon provinces).
The Dhofar house gecko (Hemidactylus lemurinus) is confined to a few areas of southern Yemen and Oman, where it inhabits the bottoms of wadis.
Günther's house gecko (Hemidactylus modestus) is known only from a few coastal forest fragments in southeastern Kenya, where it has not been recorded in several decades.
The Dutumi house gecko (Hemidactylus tanganicus) is known only from two localities in Tanzania (Dutumi and Mkomazi national parks).
The ocellated water snake (Hydraethiops laevis) is known only from a few specimens collected in Cameroon and Gabon.
Laboute's sea snake (Hydrophis laboutei) is known only from a few specimens collected from the Chesterfield Reefs.
The broad-banded sea snake (Hydrophis mamillaris) is known only from a few specimens collected along the coasts of Pakistan, India and Sri Lanka, the last in 1926.
Smith's small-headed sea snake (Hydrophis parviceps) was long known only from two specimens collected within a small area of the southern Vietnamese coast in 1935 and 1960.
The Kalimantan sea snake (Hydrophis sibauensis) is known only from three specimens collected within a swampy area of the Sibau River, more than 1,000 kilometres upriver from the coast.
The estuarine sea snake (Hydrophis vorisi) is known only from two specimens collected from the Torres Strait between southern New Guinea and northern Australia.
The Rio Verde nightsnake (Hypsiglena tanzeri) is known only from three specimens collected from the mountains of northeastern Mexico (Querétaro and San Luis Potosí).
The Arfak forest dragon (Hypsilurus bruijnii) is confined to the Arfak Mountains.
The Palau forest dragon (Hypsilurus godeffroyi) is known only from two specimens of uncertain provenence collected in 1867.
The Bosavi forest dragon (Hypsilurus ornatus) is a type of lizard known only from Mount Bosavi.
The Darjeeling blind snake (Indotyphlops meszoelyi) is known only from single specimen collected in northeastern India (West Bengal).
The Samagutin worm snake (Indotyphlops tenuicollis) is known only from three specimens collected in the Naga Hills.
The circular-scaled chameleon (Kinyongia gyrolepis) is known only from a few specimens collected mainly in the Lendu Plateau's now mostly-cleared forests.
species.iucn: Kinyongia gyrolepis Greenbaum, Tolley, Joma & Kusamba, 2012

species.e: The Santa Catalina kingsnake (Lampropeltis catalinensis) is confined to Santa Catalina Island.
Webb's mountain kingsnake (Lampropeltis webbi) is known only from a few specimens collected from Sinaloa and Durango states.
Bulel's scaly-toed gecko (Lepidodactylus buleli) is known only from the western coast of Espiritu Santo, but may perhaps range more widely.
The Admiralty scaly-toed gecko (Lepidodactylus pulcher) is known only from a few islands and has rarely been collected.
The Eastern Rift worm snake (Leptotyphlops keniensis) is known only from Mount Kenya and environs, and from Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania.
The Mbanja worm snake (Leptotyphlops mbanjensis) is known only from five specimens collected from extreme southeastern Tanzania.

Parker's worm snake (Leptotyphlops parkeri) is known only from two specimens collected many decades ago from two, widely-separated localities (the northern Ogaden region of Ethiopia and Tsavo National Park in Kenya).
The Halfeti blind snake (Letheobia episcopus) is known only from two localities in the Euprhates River Valley of southeastern Turkey.
The Eritrean blind snake (Letheobia erythraea) is known only from two localities in the arid central highlands of Eritrea.
The Zanzibar blind snake (Letheobia pallida) is a little-known species confined to Zanzibar.

The Maintikibo snake (Liophidium maintikibo) is known only from two specimens collected from the Kirindy Forest and the Andranomena Special Reserve in western coastal Madagascar (former Toliara province).
species.iucn: Liophidium maintikibo Franzen, Jones, Raselimanana, Nagy, D’Cruze, Glaw & Vences, 2009

species.e: Haad's blind snake (Liotyphlops haadi) is known only from two specimens collected from southeastern Colombia (Vaupés and Amazonas departments).
The black slender skink (Lipinia rabori) is confined to southern Negros.
Semper's skink (Lipinia semperi) is known only from historical records originating in Mindanao, Camiguin and possibly Samar.
Brongersma's skink (Lipinia venemai) is known only from two localities within the central Vogelkop Peninsula (Papua Barat province, Indonesia).
Cornfield's fringed gecko (Luperosaurus corfieldi) is known only from three specimens collected from far northwestern Panay.
Cuming's fringed gecko (Luperosaurus cumingii) is confined to southern Luzon and the satellite island of Polillo.
The Jolo fringed gecko (Luperosaurus joloensis) is known only from a small number of specimens collected on Jolo.
The Cardamom wolf snake (Lycodon cardamomensis) is known only from a few specimens collected in the Cardamom Mountains.
The Manila wolf snake (Lycodon tessellatus) is known only from a single museum specimen collected in 1846 and labelled “Manila.” The Luzon wolf snake (L.
The Pemba wolf snake (Lycophidion pembanum) is confined to forests and plantations on Pemba Island.
Decary's dwarf gecko (Lygodactylus decaryi) is known only from specimens collected from Andrahamana, Angavo and Behara in southern Madagascar (former Toliara province) between the 1930s and 1950s.
Grandison's dwarf gecko (Lygodactylus grandisonae) is known only from a few specimens collected from a single locality on the Kenya / Ethiopia border.

The Dar-es-Salaam dwarf gecko (Lygodactylus inexpectatus) is known only from the Dar-es-Salaam area of Tanzania, where it has not been recorded since its original description in the mid-twentieth century.
Scheffler's dwarf gecko (Lygodactylus scheffleri) is known only from two localities in southeastern Kenya in the vicinity of the Chyulu Hills and Kibwezi, where it was last recorded in the 1930s.
Gasperett's snake (Lytorhynchus gasperetti) is known only from a few specimens collected during the 1970s primarily from the southeastern Asir Mountains.
The Andasibe blind snake (Madatyphlops andasibensis) is known only from Andasibe in east-central Madagascar (former Toamasina province).
The Comoros blind snake (Madatyphlops comorensis) is a burrowing species known only from a few specimens collected on Grande Comore and, in one instance, Anjouan.
Barbour's whip snake (Masticophis barbouri) is confined to Espiritu Santo and Partida Sur off the southeastern coast of the Baja California Peninsula.

Spannring's leaf-toed gecko (Matoatoa spannringi) was long known only from a few microhabitats at Fiadanana in southeastern Madagascar (former Fianarantsoa province), though more recently a single specimen was recorded from Sainte Luce in the far southeast (former Toliara province).
The keel-scaled bent-toed gecko (Mediodactylus aspratilis) is known only from two localities in southwestern Iran (Fars province).
The Iraqi bent-toed gecko (Mediodactylus heteropholis) is known only from two specimens collected in the foothills of western Iran and northeastern Iraq.
The Gabou file snake (Mehelya gabouensis) is known only from two specimens collected in 1996 from southwestern Senegal.
The Tana delta smooth snake (Meizodon krameri) is known only from two specimens collected in 1934 from the Tana River delta.
The Ayun sand lizard (Mesalina ayunensis) is known only from a small area of southwestern Oman.

The Lord Howe red-fronted parakeet (Cyanoramphus subflavescens) was last reported in 1869.

Mauge's parakeet (Psittacara maugei), which may or may not have historically ranged on Puerto Rico itself, was last seen on Mona Island in 1882.

Philip's skate (Okamejei philipi) is a poorly-known species from the Gulf of Aden.
The Australian cownose ray (Rhinoptera neglecta) is found disjunctly in northern and northeastern coastal Australia, where it is threatened by fisheries bycatch.

The whitetail dogfish (Scymnodalatias albicauda) has a patchy distribution in the southern oceans, where it has been recorded from the southeastern Atlantic, southern Indian and southwestern Pacific oceans.
The frog shark (Somniosus longus) is a very rare deepwater species known from fewer than a dozen specimens collected patchily from across the Pacific Ocean, though mainly in the region of Japan.

Roosevelts' muntjac (Muntiacus rooseveltorum) was long known only by a single specimen collected from northern Laos (Phongsali province) in 1929.
